A.change: multiply original completed max-confidence candidate AR scores by established factor, then candidate-only per-user maximum normalization

B_C.A_ui: 1 if any >=80% qualifying training airing, zero otherwise
B_C.C_ij: sum_u A_ui*Y_uj = A.T@Y; asymmetric fractional float64 mass
B_C.Y: Top-K membership: all 1 when positives<=K; above Kth count 1, below 0; boundary tie (K-a)/b
B_C.Y_row_sum: min(K, number of positive training programmes)
B_C.catalogue: all training programmes, before target filtering
B_C.user_population: exact original AR usable-primary80 population, all training users

bootstrap.interval: paired-user descriptive percentile 95%, all three cohorts

conditional_refit: one frozen qualifying hybrid only; no CSV if none
conditional_refit_candidates: hybrids A/B/C only; standalone results are diagnostic

control.EASE: training-only globally normalized log1p primary80, lambda1000, opportunity adjustment before candidate-only max
control.arithmetic: preserve evaluated nested order .90*(.70*R_norm + .30*AR_norm) + .10*E_norm rather than rounding/reassociating scores
control.repeat: unchanged adjusted repeat50 counts, no decay

diagnostics: familiar vs no personal >=50% repeat evidence, plus existing global/history-size partitions; never extra models or selection targets

fallback_ranking.fallback: cutoff-specific >=80% training popularity restricted to the applicable candidate pool
fallback_ranking.fusion: weighted sum of normalized scores; no score rounding
fallback_ranking.normalization: per-user max normalization over eligible candidate scores

interpretation: retrospective preference associations, not calibrated future Top-5 probabilities
normalization: independent positive component maxima over eligible candidates; standalone uses the same normalized AR component
reuse: verified repeat and adjusted weighted-EASE components; each of A/B/C AR signals reused for standalone and hybrid

rule_settings.antecedent_order: original training count descending then sorted catalogue column index
rule_settings.candidate_filter: rules after full-catalogue statistics, before top-50 pruning
rule_settings.rule_order: confidence descending then sorted catalogue column index

selection.tie_break: lower measured component cost summed across both splits; retain Stage 13 on exact cost tie

splits: unchanged Stage 8 horizon12 and original10 labels, users, pools, cutoffs, cohorts and boundaries
uncertainty: overlapping repeatedly used historical periods; selection-unadjusted evidence, not independent confirmation
